scope: Spline kinematic-sampling sub_q2_7, 3D BC_RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/sub_q2_7/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the BC_RC keys these 452 histograms select have median B width 0.17 and only 5 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.10 with 10 narrower than 0.05, so those windows are not tight. 305 of 452 leave B unlimited and 364 leave C unlimited. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the run-local copy of the universal spline file and the corrected filled-window range. 450 selected spline keys match the manual keys that made the stored fit, so those histograms did not move. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) is the spline 3D-BC key rather than the tighter manual BC key, and that pass lowered its chi-squared from 2.532 to 2.016. (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_32) already sat inside the wider spline window and did not move. Pass 2 opened only the histograms whose own cosine was outside the guide or was stuck in the rough-start window. It did not copy nominal parameters. JSON still has 452 bins. 22 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.05. Largest drops: (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 41.890 to 20.799; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 19.877 to 7.163; (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 12.360 to 2.193; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_33) 9.508 to 3.066; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_24) 28.022 to 21.956; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 21.879 to 16.093; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_22) 12.155 to 7.800; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_17) 9.825 to 6.247. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was stored at the second-pass edge B=-0.045 from the legacy BC limits [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]. It is kept at B=-0.124329, statistical error 0.050948, C=-0.054038, error 0.040362, chi-squared 13.925, NDF 13.0, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal BC B=-0.116016 and not the acceptance B=-0.125191.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.263348 versus nominal -0.347901, shift +0.084553; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.252495 versus nominal -0.329563, shift +0.077068; (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_6) B=-0.232909 versus nominal -0.294021, shift +0.061113. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero. The Q2 subdivision source was not removed.
unresolved: No retained bin is still more than 1 chi-squared above its own unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 2.643 (chi2 55.512, NDF 21.0). Isolated spikes that the cosine already follows: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 6.54 at 352 deg, fraction 0.77. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is not unresolved as a guide miss. No empty histograms.
why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 22 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each sub_q2_7 histogram. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Near-zero parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
